snippet.title: Cebus VR is BACK and Better Than Ever | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the world of Cebus — the hit Gorilla Tag fan game that's taken over Meta Quest! 🦍

This trailer is WILD — we dropped into the Cebus VR jungle, got swarmed by fans, took selfies mid-climb, and proved why this Gorilla Tag fan game is DOMINATING the Meta Quest charts! If you love insane VR moments, chaotic gorilla energy, and meeting fans in the wild… you’re gonna love this.

🎮 Play Cebus now on Meta Quest:
👉 https://www.meta.com/experiences/cebus/6404015439622172/
